name: Isla Bella Beach Resort & Spa
positioning: Oceanfront resort on Knights Key in Marathon, in the Florida Keys, with Greek-inspired architecture and an ocean view from every room
best_for: Families and groups wanting suites or two-bedroom guestrooms by the beach
Divers, anglers and kayakers exploring the Middle Keys
Couples looking for a spa and pool-centered beach stay

facts.text: The resort sits on 24 oceanfront acres.
It is on Knights Key in Marathon, midway between Miami and Key West.
Rooms are decorated in a palette of blue and white, with modern furniture and contemporary art.
Each room has floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to a private terrace.
Room types include double queen rooms, one-bedroom suites with sofa beds, two-bedroom guestrooms and select suites with kitchenettes.
Guests can choose from five oceanfront pools set among palm-lined sandy shores.
The Spa at Isla Bella is a 4,000-square-foot space with a couples massage room and a steam room in each locker room.
The spa's Wellness Lounge offers a 20-minute couple's foot massage and a 20-minute Detoxifying Foot Soak.
Fishing charters depart from the resort's own marina.
Dive Isla Bella offers over 30 dive locations, with Sombrero Reef Sanctuary as its premier dive site.
Guided clear kayak eco-tours explore mangroves, seagrass flats and Boot Key Harbor.
Mahina is the resort's signature oceanfront restaurant, built around fresh seafood and seasonal ingredients.

highlights.text: Every room and suite has an ocean view and a furnished private outdoor living area.
Ground-floor veranda rooms open directly onto the beach, while balcony rooms on the second or third floor have a private terrace overlooking the ocean.
Conde Nast Traveler describes whitewashed, Greek-inspired architecture with blue and white interiors.
From October through January the resort hosts holiday events for the whole family, from ice skating at the beach to circus shows.

considerations.text: Parking is not included in the resort fee and is charged daily for self-parking or valet.
A resort fee applies; it includes complimentary bicycle rental.
WhataHotel notes that the Keys location means a longer journey from the mainland.
